g.text: Top-1 pose recovery across seven docking methods

g.text: Known binding site · Receptor-fixed coordinates · Symmetry-aware heavy-atom RMSD ≤ 2 Å

text.style: font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526571

g.text: Bars: case-weighted mean of three repeats; markers: individual repeats. Failures remain in each cohort denominator.

text.style: font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526571

g.text: Common cohort: receptor-preparation support frozen before new RMSD evaluation; run failures still count as unsuccessful.

text.style: font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526571

g.text: No ligand fitting. Computational budgets are unmatched. LeDock repeats are separate process trials without controlled engine seeds.

text.style: font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526571

g.text: Cases share targets; repeat points are descriptive, not confidence intervals or independent samples. Training overlap varies by method.
